items.title: add_note.py: branch-scoped notes, remove N, edit N
items.action: Copy the planned tests/skills/test_add_note_script.py over the repo file first. In add_note.py: (1) add BRANCH_KEY = "branch" and OTHER_BRANCH_MARK = "now on" beside NOTES_VERSION. (2) current_branch(repo) -> Optional[str]: `git -C <repo> rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` through subprocess; None on a failure or the literal HEAD (detached). (3) note_body(note, current) -> str: the text alone for a note without a usable branch (absent, not a string, or blank after strip); `[<branch>] <text>` when the branch equals current or current is None; `[<branch>; now on <current>] <text>` otherwise (OTHER_BRANCH_MARK in the middle). note_line(i, note, current) = f"{i}. {note_body(note, current)}". (4) add(path, words, branch): stores {added, branch, text}, leaving the key out when branch is None; returns `note N/20: <note_body(note, branch)>`. checked_text's full-file message names both `remove` and `clear`. (5) remove(path, number, current) and edit(path, number, words, current): number counts the usable notes read_notes returns (1-based); out of range raises NoteError `no note N; K stored`. edit runs checked_text without the full-file check, and keeps added and branch. Each returns `removed note N: <body>` or `edited note N: <body>` then a newline and listing(path, current). (6) listing(path, current) uses note_line. (7) parse_args: `add [--standing] text...`, `remove number` (int), `edit number text...`; run() resolves current = current_branch(args.repo) and passes branch None for --standing. Update the module docstring and Usage line. read_notes keeps passing a non-string branch through; note_body treats it as standing. Keep functions under 50 lines; Optional, not X | None.

items.title: session-bookmark: deliver the bookmark when another mod kept session.compact from reaching it
items.action: Per D5 (fallback-next-prompt). bookmark.ts: a module-level record { installed: boolean; owed: boolean }. The session.compact handler sets installed = true once it appended the bookmark. A `session.append` hook with matcher { door: 'compaction' } on the main loop (e.agentId undefined) calls next first, then sets owed = !installed. A `prompt.submit` hook on the main loop: when owed, builds a bookmark (trigger 'detected', git and live notes, lastMessages [] since the compacted prompts are gone, instructions null), stores it in bookmarkState, and passes formatBookmark(b) in e.context to next; then resets installed and owed. Reset installed at each prompt.submit too, so the next compaction starts clean. Every hook passes through on any failure (.catch to next). types/index.d.ts: trigger gains 'detected' with a doc line. bookmark.test.ts: a world whose compaction row arrives with no session.compact dispatch through the mod (call session.append with door 'compaction', then a prompt) shows the bookmark in the prompt's context once; a normal compaction followed by its row and a prompt adds no context; a subagent's compaction row owes nothing. Check the engine type docs for session.append and prompt.submit context in a `.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts` generated beside another mod. README: what the fallback does and its limit (a mid-turn auto-compaction gets the bookmark only at the next prompt; the fallback bookmark carries no recent prompts).
